notImplemented: This provider type is not implemented yet.
needsSetup: Server isn't set up yet: CA, certificates and config need to be generated.

address.label: Address
address.tip: The client's address in the VPN subnet (assigned server-side) -- use this to identify a client, not Endpoint: several clients can connect from the same external IP (shared NAT/ISP)

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.tip: Network address (IP:port) the client actually connected from last time

handshake.label: Handshake
handshake.tip: When the client last exchanged keys with the server — essentially, the last time it was seen

owner.label: Owner
owner.tip: Portal user this device is assigned to — they'll be able to download the config/QR and see it in self-service (/portal). Only accounts with the "user" role can be assigned.

actions.confirmRotate: Reissue keys for {{name}}? The client's current config will stop working.
actions.rotateKeys: Reissue keys (e.g. if the client was added outside the panel)
actions.muteOff: Notifications are off — click to turn on
actions.muteOn: Notifications are on — click to mute

pendingApproved.message: User "{{username}}" was approved, but the client hasn't been created yet
pendingApproved.description: It couldn't be created automatically (or this provider type only supports manual setup) — create the client below and the panel will link it to the user.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.tip: Server address (host:port) written into the client config

publicKey.label: Public key
publicKey.tip: Server's public key — the client uses it to verify it's connecting to this exact server

form.ownPublicKeyPlaceholder: leave empty for the panel to generate a key

importPeer.title: Import existing certificate
importPeer.description: Adopt a client certificate already issued by this server before the panel took it over — instead of issuing a new one. Only works once the provider's current CA is the one that actually signed this certificate (import it first on the Settings tab if you haven't yet).
importPeer.keyPemTooltip: Pasting the key enables config/QR downloads for this client later. Without it, the client keeps using its own existing config file — the panel can still see and manage (e.g. revoke) it either way.
